description: The ten MCP tools registered by pdftract. tools/list exposes only entries whose advertised value is true.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Extract text and structure from a PDF file, returning the full document JSON

tools.name: extract_text
tools.description: Extract plain text from a PDF file

tools.name: extract_markdown
tools.description: Extract text from a PDF file and format it as Markdown

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search for a regex pattern across the PDF, returning matches with page and bbox coordinates

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Get PDF metadata, outline, and fingerprint without full extraction (fast, < 250ms for 100-page PDFs)

tools.name: hash
tools.description: Compute the structural fingerprint of a PDF (fast, < 100ms for 100-page PDFs)

tools.name: get_table
tools.mapping_note: Deliberate MCP-only specialized table extraction; the shared SDK contract has no table-result type or method.
tools.description: Extract a single table by page and table index

tools.name: get_form_fields
tools.mapping_note: Deliberate MCP-only specialized AcroForm/XFA access; the shared SDK contract has no form-field method.

tools.name: get_attachments
tools.mapping_note: Deliberate MCP-only specialized embedded-file access; the shared SDK contract has no attachment method.
tools.description: Extract embedded files from the PDF

tools.name: classify
tools.description: Run the PDF classifier to categorize the document
